qa.overall_assessment: Title change feature works correctly in the running application. Created a new session via the UI, Claude responded and proactively set an initial title, then successfully changed title on explicit user request. All 4 acceptance criteria verified on both desktop and mobile viewports.

success_criteria_results.criterion: AC1: Claude should NOT say 'endpoint connection error'. Should confirm title changed.
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Sent 'Please change the session title to Title Fix Working' via browser UI, waited for Claude response
success_criteria_results.details: Claude responded with 'Done -- title changed to Title Fix Working'. No error messages of any kind.
evidence: Accessibility tree ref=e181: 'Done -- title changed to "Title Fix Working".'
No 'endpoint connection error' text found anywhere in the page

success_criteria_results.criterion: AC2: Service message 'Title changed to Title Fix Working' should appear
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Checked accessibility tree for service message after title change
evidence: Accessibility tree ref=e186: 'Title changed to "Title Fix Working"'
Visible in both desktop and mobile screenshots

success_criteria_results.criterion: AC3: Sidebar/header should update with new title
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Checked session header in accessibility tree after title change
success_criteria_results.details: Header updated from 'Title Change Verification Test' to 'Title Fix Working'
evidence: Screenshot header clearly shows 'Title Fix Working'

success_criteria_results.criterion: AC4: No tool block visible (only service message)
success_criteria_results.verification_method: Inspected accessibility tree for tool-call blocks or tool UI elements
success_criteria_results.details: No tool-call-start, tool-call-end, or tool block elements visible in the message list. Only the service message and Claude's text response are shown.
evidence: Full accessibility snapshot shows only: text response (e181), service message (e186), user message (e172)
No collapsible tool blocks or 'change_title' tool UI elements in the tree

root_cause_verification.rationale: The title change MCP tool successfully communicated with the happy-server endpoint. Claude called the change_title tool, it returned success, a service message appeared in the chat, and the header updated. This confirms the endpoint connection issue (the original bug) is resolved.
